messages:
Marta (Sales): Prospect wants a 4-week EU-only pilot. Key asks: strict region pin (single EU region), EU-only subprocessor list, BYOK details, and a single-line ballpark for procurement. Need quick confirm so I can reply today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jules (Solutions): We can do strict pin on Dedicated or Private. Hosted = affinity only. For BYOK, customer needs HSM in-region. Which EU region do they want pinned?
Marta (Sales): They asked for Frankfurt (eu-central-1).
Ibrahim (Infra): Confirmed: eu-central-1 pin supported on Dedicated/Private. EU subprocessors for that stack: AWS eu-central-1 (compute), EdgePoint EU (POP NL/DE), VaultEU (HSM), LogStore EU (logs in eu-central-1). I'll upload attestation links.
Clare (Legal): Add DPA + SCCs. For "no cross-border egress" during pilot we need an explicit clause; emergency fallback requires written approval. I'll draft a one-paragraph blurb.
Jules (Solutions): Quick test curl for buyer: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://inference.eu-central-1.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'```
Marta (Sales): Pricing ask: single-line for procurement (monthly + one-time). Ops/Infra, any ballpark?
Ibrahim (Infra): Ballpark: $24k/month reserved + $7k one-time BYOK/integration + $1k peering. One-line: "EU-only POC (eu-central-1 pin, BYOK) est. $24k/mo + $8k one-time."
OpsBot: Deployment ticket created #POC-794. ETA infra details in ticket by EOD.
